verses.original: וָאָשׁ֕וּב וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֖י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֥ה עָפָֽה׃
verses.literal: Again I lifted up my eyes and saw before me a flying scroll
verses.literalPt: E OUTRA vez levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis um rolo volante.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אָרְכָּהּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרָחְבָּ֖הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּאַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay māh ’at·tāh rō·’eh wā·’ō·mar ’ă·nî rō·’eh mə·ḡil·lāh ‘ā·p̄āh ’ā·rə·kāh ‘eś·rîm bā·’am·māh wə·rā·ḥə·bāh ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh
verses.literal: What do you see asked the angel . . . I see a flying scroll I replied twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide
verses.literalPt: E disse-me o anjo: Que vês? E eu disse: Vejo um rolo volante, que tem vinte côvados de comprido e dez côvados de largo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֹ֚את הָֽאָלָ֔ה הַיּוֹצֵ֖את עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כָל־ הַגֹּנֵ֗ב מִזֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹהָ נִקָּ֔ה וְכָל־ הַנִּ֨שְׁבָּ֔ע מִזֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹהָ נִקָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay zōṯ hā·’ā·lāh hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ kî ḵāl hag·gō·nêḇ miz·zeh kā·mō·w·hā niq·qāh wə·ḵāl han·niš·bā‘ miz·zeh kā·mō·w·hā niq·qāh
verses.literal: Then he told me This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land for according to one side of the scroll every thief will be removed and according to the other side every perjurer will be removed
verses.literalPt: Então disse-me: Esta é a maldição que sairá pela face de toda a terra; porque qualquer que furtar, será desarraigado, conforme está estabelecido de um lado do rolo; como também qualquer que jurar falsamente, será desarraigado, conforme está estabelecido do outro lado do rolo.

verses.original: הוֹצֵאתִ֗יהָ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֙אָה֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְאֶל־ בֵּ֛ית הַנִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְלָ֙נֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכִלַּ֖תּוּ וְאֶת־ עֵצָ֥יו וְאֶת־ אֲבָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ṣê·ṯî·hā nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ū·ḇā·’āh ’el- bêṯ hag·gan·nāḇ wə·’el- bêṯ han·niš·bā‘ biš·mî laš·šā·qer wə·lā·neh bə·ṯō·wḵ bê·ṯōw wə·ḵil·lat·tū wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ṣāw wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇā·nāw
verses.literal: I will send it out declares the LORD of Hosts and it will enter . . . the house of the thief . . . and the house of him who swears falsely by My name It will remain inside his house and destroy it down to its timbers and stones
verses.literalPt: Eu a farei sair, disse o SENHOR dos Exércitos, e ela entrará na casa do ladrão, e na casa do que jurar falsamente pelo meu nome; e permanecerá no meio da sua casa, e a consumirá juntamente com a sua madeira e com as suas pedras.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֕א הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַיּוֹצֵ֥את הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ham·mal·’āḵ had·dō·ḇêr bî way·yō·mer ’ê·lay śā nā ‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh māh hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Then the angel who was speaking with me came forward and told me Now lift up your eyes and see what is approaching
verses.literalPt: E saiu o anjo, que falava comigo, e disse-me: Levanta agora os teus olhos, e vê que é isto que sai.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר מַה־ הִ֑יא וַיֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽאֵיפָה֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔את וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖ם בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar mah- hî way·yō·mer zōṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ way·yō·mer zōṯ ‘ê·nām bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: What is it I asked And he replied A measuring basket is going forth Then he continued This is their iniquity in all the land
verses.literalPt: E eu disse: Que é isto? E ele disse: Isto é um efa que sai. Disse ainda: Este é o aspecto deles em toda a terra.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְזֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh kik·kar ‘ō·p̄e·reṯ niś·śêṯ wə·zōṯ ’iš·šāh ’a·ḥaṯ yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: And behold the cover of lead was raised . . . and there was a woman sitting inside the basket
verses.literalPt: E eis que foi levantado um talento de chumbo, e uma mulher estava assentada no meio do efa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָרִשְׁעָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־ אֶ֥בֶן הָעֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל־ פִּֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer zōṯ hā·riš·‘āh way·yaš·lêḵ ’ō·ṯāh ’el- tō·wḵ hā·’ê·p̄āh way·yaš·lêḵ ’eṯ- ’e·ḇen hā·‘ō·p̄e·reṯ ’el- pî·hā
verses.literal: This is Wickedness he said And he shoved her down into . . . the basket pushing down the lead cover over its opening
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Esta é a impiedade. E a lançou dentro do efa; e lançou sobre a boca deste o peso de chumbo.

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜י וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְר֣וּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָהֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּכַנְפֵ֣י הַחֲסִידָ֑ה וַתִּשֶּׂ֙אנָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֵ֥ין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh šə·ta·yim nā·šîm yō·wṣ·’ō·wṯ wə·rū·aḥ bə·ḵan·p̄ê·hem wə·lā·hên·nāh ḵə·nā·p̄a·yim kə·ḵan·p̄ê ha·ḥă·sî·ḏāh wat·tiś·śe·nāh ’eṯ- hā·’ê·p̄āh bên hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇên haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw . . . two women approaching with the wind in their wings Their wings were like those of a stork and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth
verses.literalPt: E levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis que saíram duas mulheres; e traziam vento nas suas asas, pois tinham asas como as da cegonha; e levantaram o efa entre a terra e o céu.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת־ הָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’el- ham·mal·’āḵ had·dō·ḇêr bî ’ā·nāh hêm·māh mō·w·li·ḵō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: Where are they taking the basket I asked . . . the angel who was speaking with me
verses.literalPt: Então eu disse ao anjo que falava comigo: Para onde levam elas o efa?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י לִבְנֽוֹת־ לָ֥הֿ בַ֖יִת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֑ר וְהוּכַ֛ן וְהֻנִּ֥יחָה שָּׁ֖ם עַל־ מְכֻנָתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay liḇ·nō·wṯ- lāh ḇa·yiṯ bə·’e·reṣ šin·‘ār wə·hū·ḵan wə·hun·nî·ḥāh šām ‘al- mə·ḵu·nā·ṯāh
verses.literal: To build a house for it in the land of Shinar he told me And when it is ready the basket will be set there on its pedestal
verses.literalPt: E ele me disse: Para lhe edificarem uma casa na terra de Sinar; e, estando ela acabada, ele será posto ali na sua base.
